CustomField.description: Picto list representing the plaforms size 48 pix (list view purpose)
CustomField.formula: TRIM( IF(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'bankrupt'),IMAGE('/resource/Icons/Icons/Account/Stop.png', 'Bankrupt', 48, 48), (IF(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'blocked'),IMAGE('/resource/Icons/Icons/Account/Blocked.png', 'Blocked', 48, 48),'') + ' ' + IF(ISBLANK( extId_1__c ),'',IMAGE('/resource/Platforms/Platforms/1'+IF(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'blocked'),'_grey','')+'.png', extId_1__c, 48, 48)) + ' ' + IF(ISBLANK( extId_2__c ),'',IMAGE('/resource/Platforms/Platforms/2'+IF(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'blocked'),'_grey','')+'.png', extId_2__c, 48, 48)) + ' ' + IF(ISBLANK( extId_3__c ),'',IMAGE('/resource/Platforms/Platforms/3'+IF(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'blocked'),'_grey','')+'.png', extId_3__c, 48, 48)) + ' ' + IF(ISBLANK( extId_4__c ),'',IMAGE('/resource/Platforms/Platforms/4'+IF(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'blocked'),'_grey','')+'.png', extId_4__c, 48, 48)) + ' ' + IF(ISBLANK( extId_5__c ),'',IMAGE('/resource/Platforms/Platforms/5'+IF(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'blocked'),'_grey','')+'.png', extId_5__c, 48, 48)) + ' ' + IF(ISBLANK( extId_6__c ),'',IMAGE('/resource/Platforms/Platforms/6'+IF(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'blocked'),'_grey','')+'.png', extId_6__c, 48, 48))) ) )
CustomField.label: Health (48)
